newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 30.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Nine civilians and a soldier killed by Tamil Tiger rebel landmines in Punnalai, in northern Jaffna.
Education Ministry plans to make school compulsory for children up to 14 years of age.
Bag with 200 grammes of explosives, detonator and rifle ammunition found on board bus at main Pettah bus stand in Colombo.
Government planning to turn Colombo Fort district into security zone and ban entry of heavy vehicles and cars.
Former mayor of Colombo K. Ganeshalingam resigns from opposition United National Party to lead group of independents in forthcoming local government polls.
Government losing millions of rupees in duties because of racket by gang who buy duty free goods using passports of returning passengers, especially housemaids.
